Full-Coverage Baby Bib Smock for High Chair Feeding

Mealtime chaos ends with this full-coverage baby bib smock designed to attach directly to high chair trays. The waterproof feeding gown creates a contained barrier that captures spills and crumbs before they reach clothes or floors, transforming messy mealtimes into manageable moments.

Made from polyester cotton blend with waterproof protection, this feeding smock covers your child's entire front and connects to the high chair tray, forming a sealed feeding zone. Food stays contained, clothes stay clean, and cleanup becomes a simple wipe-down instead of multiple laundry loads.

Key Features of This High Chair Feeding Gown

✅ FULL TRAY-TO-BODY COVERAGE – Innovative design connects to high chair tray, preventing food from reaching the floor or clothing during self-feeding sessions.

✅ WATERPROOF POLYESTER COTTON – Stain-resistant material repels liquids and wipes clean in seconds, handling purees, sauces, and drinks without soaking through.

✅ ADJUSTABLE ELASTIC FIT – Flexible straps and elastic edges adapt to most high chairs and tables, fitting children from 6 months to 3 years old.

✅ PORTABLE & COMPACT – Folds small (200 x 100 x 100 mm) for restaurant visits, travel, and grandparent stays where high chair feeding happens.

How to Use This Baby Feeding Smock

1. Slide the gown over your child's head and arms
2. Secure the base to the high chair tray
3. Fasten clips or straps for a snug fit
4. Serve meals with confidence

This feeding gown supports self-feeding independence while protecting clothes and reducing floor cleanup. The Class A safety-rated design comes in four patterns: Gray Car, Pink Rabbit, Blue Lion, and Yellow Fox, suitable for unisex use.
